$comment: Single source of truth for the immutable refs that ci.yml and release.yml pin each sibling backend checkout to (§17 pin B). Each pinned commit CONTAINS the committed contract artifacts the gen:* drivers regenerate from: docs/schema.json, docs/flows.json, docs/errors.json, docs/capabilities.json (+ pyproject.toml for the manifest backend-version pin). Bumping a pin is a deliberate PR after the backend releases a new contract — never float main. Procedure: CONTRIBUTING.md, section 'Contract pins'. 2026-07-16: bumped to the v1-canon-sweep release tags (§60, api-versioning.md) — auth v0.5.8, notifications v0.3.8, profiles v0.3.13, billing v0.4.11, workspaces v0.4.2, calendar v0.3.4, recordings v0.3.2; all contracts now carry /<mod>/api/v1/ paths; react gen:* artifacts regenerated against these refs in the same change.

stapel-auth.note: release v0.12.0 — org-program security-harden primitives (W2+W3): login_grant (/grant/exchange/), first-login intermediates (FirstLoginChallengeResponse requires=password_change|mfa_enroll), /password/forced-change/, /mfa/enroll/exchange/ (enroll-only limited session), tokens on TOTP-confirm/passkey-complete for the enroll upgrade, auth.first_login flow. Pairs with @stapel/auth-react 0.9.0. Pin+regen bumped together (the discipline whose absence caused the earlier gen:check drift).

stapel-profiles.note: release v0.9.0 — POST /batch (many public profiles in one request, #111): the answer splits `profiles` from `missing`, so "no profile row" stays a normal state instead of a per-id 404. Plus the guest-surface naming sweep (#168). Pairs with @stapel/profiles-react 0.14.0's useProfilesBatch. Pin+regen bumped together.

stapel-workspaces.note: release v0.14.0 — invitation administration + administrative password reset: GET /{ws}/invitations (anchor-paginated, ?status=pending|never_accepted|all, ?search=), POST /{ws}/invitations/{id}/revoke, POST /{ws}/invitations/{id}/resend (rotates the token, restarts the TTL), POST /{ws}/members/{user}/password/reset (capability members.password.reset, declared `high` → requires_verification(scope="sensitive"); `generated_password` is returned exactly once), and settings.security.provisioned_user_policies as an independent LIST (#90, was a single string pre-0.13). Pairs with @stapel/workspaces-react 0.8.0. Pin+regen bumped together.

stapel-calendar.note: release v0.3.4 — v1 canon sweep §60: /calendar/api/v1/ paths
